candidate_program.name: preserved_residual
candidate_program.rationale: Combines local reward capture, preserved compatible mass, and blocked count fraction using separate weight and count normalizations. Includes coarse global residual context without added scans; compatible mass does not establish mutual feasibility, and aggregate refresh retains its kernel cost.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight) + 0.25 * compatible_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight) - 0.1 * degree / (1 + remaining_count)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
